land.text: the Gambia Colony and Protectorate: 'the British colonial administration of The Gambia from 1821 to 1965'

predecessors.note: Cliopatria draws the Gambia inside its 'British East Africa' shape (1961-1968), which the british-east-africa dossier closes for the Gambia at 18 February 1965.

capitals.name: Bathurst (Banjul)
capitals.note: Colony page infobox 'Capital: Bathurst'; 'The colony was the immediate area surrounding Bathurst (now Banjul)'; The Gambia page 'The capital city is the island Banjul'. Neither page dates the rename. Coordinates are Banjul's, from the gazetteer (Natural Earth). No change of seat.

correction.text: the Gambia within the frontiers of the colony and protectorate, the same land as the 1967 shape: independent on 18 February 1965

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's row begins 1967, two years after independence ('The Gambia achieved independence on 18 February 1965'). The land lies inside Cliopatria's British East Africa shape until 1968; that overlap is for the british-east-africa dossier to resolve.

11,217 km2 against the infobox 'Total: 11,300 km2' and the text 'a total area of 11,295 km2' (ratio 0.99). Gazetteer: 43 cells, the same as modern Gambia. The page describes no change of frontier after the 1889 definition.

region.text: the Gambia Colony and Protectorate: the strip about 16 km (10 mi) either side of the River Gambia

ledger.note: 18 February 1965: the Gambia becomes independent from the United Kingdom as a constitutional monarchy. 'The Gambia achieved independence on 18 February 1965, as a constitutional monarchy'; the colony page: 'The Gambia became independent on 18 February 1965.'

24 April 1970: the Gambia becomes a republic within the Commonwealth. 'On 24 April 1970, The Gambia became a Republic within the Commonwealth, following a second referendum'; Prime Minister Jawara 'assumed the office of President'. No land changes; colour continues.

wars.name: 1981 Gambian coup attempt and Senegalese intervention
belligerents: the rebel force of the 1981 coup attempt
wars.outcome: 'President Jawara requested military aid from Senegal, which deployed 400 troops to The Gambia on 31 July.' 'By 6 August, some 2,700 Senegalese troops had been deployed, defeating the rebel force.'
wars.note: 'An attempted coup on 29 July 1981 followed a weakening of the economy.' No territory changed hands; listed because Senegalese troops operated on Gambian soil and the confederation of 1982-1989 followed. The page's 2016-2017 crisis ended with 'a military intervention by ECOWAS forces in January 2017' and Jammeh leaving on 20 January 2017; also no territorial result.

certainty.note: 'The present boundaries were defined in 1889 after an agreement between the United Kingdom and France'; the colony page: 'France and Britain agreed in 1889 in principle to set the boundary at 10 km (6.2 miles) north and south of the river' while The Gambia page says 'about 16 kilometres (10 mi)'. The French kept 'a tiny enclave at Albreda on the river's north bank' at that time.

sources.title: The Gambia

notes: Cliopatria row 'Republic of The Gambia' begins 1967 against independence on 18 February 1965, so a 1965-1966 keyframe is added; it overlaps British East Africa (1961-1968) in 1967-1968. The Senegambia Confederation is not territory (rule 4: associations are never territory) and is not in the ledger: 'In 1982, in the aftermath of the 1981 attempted coup, Senegal and The Gambia signed a treaty of confederation. The Gambia permanently withdrew from the confederation in 1989' (infobox: 'Dissolution of the Senegambia Confederation: 30 September 1989'); it is reported as a counterpart needing an umbrella dossier. The two pages disagree on the 1889 strip: 10 km (colony page) or 16 km (The Gambia page). The colony page does not date internal self-government (it names the 1960 constitution and 1962 elections only) and gives no referendums; The Gambia page's remark that under Jammeh the country was 'backing up rebels of MFDC in Casamance' moved no frontier. Rulers omitted. Page budget: two pages. native_names left empty: no page read gives one.
